task: Replace legacy ranking module with a new scoring module

interface: Preserve confidence and reason fields for consumers
engineering: Use configuration to switch the active algorithm
Keep rollback path available until runtime validation passes

steps: Inspect the ranking module entry point
Compare old and new algorithm output schema
Add an adapter if the new scorer omits required metadata
Switch configuration to the new scorer
Run interface, runtime, configuration, and rollback validation

problems.symptom: metadata.reason is missing in downstream validation
problems.root_cause: The new scorer returned a different metadata shape
The configuration switch was not updated

solutions.solution: Add an adapter that preserves the metadata contract expected by downstream stages
Update configuration and verify runtime metadata shows the new scorer

reusable_experience: Do not declare algorithm replacement complete until runtime metadata proves the new algorithm is active
Treat metadata schema compatibility as part of the public interface
Keep rollback ready while validating the new implementation
